title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
setup: 400+ models, 70M-16B params, 5B-500B tokens, Chinchilla scaling suite
assumptions: power-law regime holds over the fitted range
evidence_strength: author experiment; third-party replication raises fit concerns (arXiv:2404.10102)
limitations: fit range limited; extrapolation to frontier scale uncertain
allocation depends on tokenizer and data distribution
key_claims: compute-optimal training uses roughly 20 tokens per parameter
model size and data should scale roughly equally with compute
